prose.en: A There are a number of special words in English which are used to describe different kinds of containers. Look at the following pictures.
B Here is some additional information about each of these types of containers.
*A case of wine is usually a cardboard box of wine, containing 12 bottles. Half a case is six bottles.

note: Left page: two short presentation introductions (A, B) plus a footnote; the rest is a labelled picture set and a container/contents table without example sentences. Right page is exercises only (already captured).
